title: Fleet Fuel Delivery Receipt Form
subtitle: Reconcile the promised fleet fuel delivery with actual units, condition, custody, evidence, exceptions, receiving decision, and accountable handoff.
description: An original, fillable fleet fuel delivery receipt form for controlling bulk or mobile fleet-fuel delivery and tank inventory through delivery receipt identity, observations, evidence, decision, exceptions, escalation, completion, handoff, and final verification without replacing applicable requirements or professional review.
use_case: Use at Fleet tank, generator, equipment, or authorized vehicle group when authorized fleet-fuel site or mobile fueling contact and the delivering custodian need one receipt that separates physical handoff from inspection, hold, commercial acceptance, and exception resolution.

sections.title: Fleet Fuel delivery receipt identity and routing
sections.guidance: Anchor the record to the exact work, parties, locations, and source references.

fields.label: Fuel order, delivery ticket, and route number

Fuel Driver And Authorized Site Receiver

blocks.guidance: Preserve linkage to the fuel order, product record, tank chart, meter ticket, and site procedure.

sections.title: Fleet Fuel delivery commitment and receiving readiness
sections.guidance: Confirm what was expected, where it was due, and which controls governed acceptance.

fields.label: Fuel grade, tank capacity, transfer, ignition, and spill control
Authorized Fleet-Fuel Site Or Mobile Fueling Contact

blocks.label: Fleet Fuel delivery and receiving controls
items: Verify product before hose connection
No smoking or open flame
Control vehicle and pedestrian access
Apply site bonding or grounding procedure
Attend transfer continuously
Monitor tank level and overfill control
Keep spill response and emergency stop accessible
Stop for leak, spill, wrong product, or unsafe condition
blocks.guidance: Confirm applicable controls before unloading, opening, moving, or accepting the delivered units.

sections.title: Fleet Fuel delivered-unit reconciliation
sections.guidance: Reconcile each delivered identity and quantity before relying on totals or signatures.

blocks.label: Fuel Compartments, Tanks, Meters, Products, Seals, And Delivered Volumes received

columns.label: Vehicle, compartment, tank, meter, hose, or seal ID
Tank, hose, fitting, containment, and product condition
Fuel grade, tank capacity, transfer, ignition, and spill control

blocks.label: Receipt totals and reconciliation
blocks.guidance: Ordered, metered, corrected, and accepted volume

sections.title: Fleet Fuel condition inspection and receipt evidence
sections.guidance: Preserve observations made before the receiver changes packaging, custody, or physical condition.

blocks.label: Fleet Fuel receipt inspection
items: Fuel order, product grade, destination tank, and fill-point label agree
Tank available capacity supports the planned delivery with operating margin
Compartment, seal, meter, hose, nozzle, fitting, and cap identities are traceable
No leak, damage, loose connection, blocked vent, or containment defect is visible
Ignition, smoking, traffic, pedestrian, and unauthorized-access controls are active
Bonding or grounding and static-control steps follow the applicable site procedure
Extinguisher, spill response equipment, emergency stop, and communication are accessible
Starting gauge, water check, meter start, and product appearance are acceptable
Transfer remains attended and observations can be recorded throughout delivery
Any wrong-product, leak, spill, capacity, fire, or unsafe-site concern stops transfer

blocks.label: Receipt evidence index
blocks.guidance: Record only necessary proof and preserve privacy or security restrictions.

blocks.label: Condition, count, custody, and acceptance narrative

fields.label: Condition, count, custody, and acceptance narrative

blocks.guidance: Describe facts that cannot be reconstructed from the line table or evidence reference.

sections.title: Fleet Fuel exception, containment, and escalation
sections.guidance: Make the trigger, affected scope, immediate control, owner, deadline, and escalation reconstructable.

blocks.label: Fleet Fuel exception indicators
items: Wrong fuel grade, destination tank, or fill point
Insufficient tank capacity or unreliable gauge
Broken seal, product appearance concern, or water indication
Leak, loose fitting, damaged hose, cap, vent, or containment
Spill, overfill, fire, vapor, static, or ignition-source concern
Meter failure or delivered volume cannot be reconciled
Unauthorized person, vehicle movement, or uncontrolled site access
Emergency stop, extinguisher, spill kit, or communication unavailable
Receiver refuses product, quantity, or condition
Environmental, safety, or site notification remains incomplete
blocks.guidance: Select every observed condition; do not use a generic exception mark when the actual trigger is known.

blocks.label: Receipt hold, partial acceptance, refusal, or resolution

sections.title: Fleet Fuel receipt decision and custody transfer
sections.guidance: Separate physical custody from final commercial, quality, safety, or financial acceptance.

blocks.label: Delivery and receiving attestation
blocks.guidance: Attestation confirms the recorded physical event, not waiver of a concealed issue or unresolved review.

sections.title: Fleet Fuel delivery receipt closeout and accountable handoff
sections.guidance: Close only when outcome, remaining limitation, next action, evidence, and receiving ownership agree.

blocks.label: Final outcome, handoff, and record location
Record boundary and stop condition
blocks.guidance: This fleet fuel delivery receipt is an operational record, not a substitute for applicable law, contract terms, safety or product requirements, or professional judgment. Stop the affected movement, transfer, release, posting, or disposition when identity, evidence, authorization, or control is uncertain. A qualified qualified fuel operations and environmental safety lead must review the exception and document the controlling decision.

blocks.label: Prepared, reviewed, and accepted

fields.label: Reviewed by qualified fuel operations and environmental safety lead

blocks.guidance: A signature records accountability for the stated decision; it does not cure missing evidence or override a stop condition.
